limitations: The corpus is locally designed and does not establish full Spark compatibility. Existing 188 differences remain.
Lists containing strings or non-numeric types and IN subqueries retain existing behavior; pure floating lists are unchanged.

Error comparison uses the existing coarse status/type/row comparator, not exact Spark error class equivalence. Three unchanged parallel plans selected different first failing values on the broad replay.

The Decimal-column/DOUBLE-literal short-list case has a measured local execution cost. Removing the common DOUBLE conversion without proving equivalence would restore incorrect results at rounding boundaries.
Performance uses finite million-row inputs, one partition and ANSI enabled. Both ANSI modes are checked for correctness. Planning overhead is reported separately from execution.
This patch remains optional and is not enabled by the default project build.
